evals.prompt: ok I think the tab close fix is done, is this ready? didn't commit yet
evals.expected_output: Apply mode on uncommitted changes. Findings pass a verify step, and the numbered report grouped Bugs, Standards, Spec, Cuts holds only Reproduced or Traced findings, ending with 'Say "apply", or name the numbers.' Nothing edited yet.
assertions: The report starts with a 'Reviewed:' line naming uncommitted changes and the sources read
Every numbered finding has a title, a category | severity | effort | evidence line, and a file:line
Every evidence label in the numbered list is Reproduced or Traced
The off-by-one in the last-tab close path is reported as a Bugs finding labeled Reproduced, with the failing command
scripts/check_quotes.py ran before the report
The report has no Judgment calls section; any are counted in a 'Left out:' line
No file in the working tree changed during the run, and no worktree is left behind (git worktree list shows only the main one)
The last line asks the user to say apply or name numbers

evals.prompt: can you review PR 285 and suggest fixes for the author? it's sam's, not mine
evals.expected_output: Suggest mode. Runs scripts/pr.py state, reads files at the head SHA, edits and posts nothing. The report ends with the standalone agent handoff line, and one line after the report offers to post the findings to the PR.
assertions: scripts/pr.py state ran before any reviewer
No local file was edited and no comment was posted
The report does not refer to the conversation
The report's last line starts with 'Nothing applied. For an agent:'
After the report, one line offers to post the findings to #285
In a planning mode, the offer says that mode has to be turned off first

No file under the skill folder changed
No connector, MCP tool, or raw API call used to post

The reply asks before posting anyway or filing an issue
